In yard canine stayed close to handler, observing surroundings. Didn't explore and would just follow handler around. Handler picked canine back up when time to go back, canine was soft bodied. Handler approached kennel, dog barked, tense body, forward posture, tight lip, handler tossed treats and crouched next to kennel, dog leaned forward, ears back, tense, low tail, ate treats gently.
